tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: Page background: near-white in light, near-black in dark. Body text in `ink`, secondary text in `ink-muted`.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Stage, ticket and card faces: white in light, a dark grey in dark. Takes `ink` and `ink-muted` text.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Wells inside a surface: grid cells, the share-text preview, idle tiles. Takes `ink` text.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on `canvas`, `surface` and `surface-sunken` (14:1 or better in both themes). Also outlines, and the fill of primary keys through `primary`.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: instructions, labels, taglines. 5.7:1 or better on every surface in both themes.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Decorative dividers and the ticket perforation only. Never the only border of a control; controls use `edge`.

tokens.name: drop
tokens.usage: Colour of the hard offset shadow under keys, tickets and cards. In dark it is a mid grey so depth still reads on `canvas`.

tokens.name: edge
tokens.usage: Outline of interactive and object elements (keys, tickets, game cards). Same as `ink`, so it always holds 3:1.

tokens.name: on-fill
tokens.usage: Text and icons on any game colour or `ticket` fill. Near-black in both themes because every fill is light; 6.7:1 or better on all of them.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: The brand colour, black in light and white in dark: primary keys, the Daily pill, a switched-on chip, the brand mark, and the ticket stub when a game has no colour of its own. Text on it is `on-primary`.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Text and marks on `primary`: white on black in light, black on white in dark. 17:1 in both themes.

tokens.name: ticket
tokens.usage: Warm yellow for "near" attempt tiles only. Not a brand colour: the brand is black and white (`primary`). Text on it: `on-fill`.

tokens.name: highlight
tokens.usage: White that stays white in both themes, for light things drawn inside a game stage: foam, shine, the paper of a card-demo scene. Never for text or surfaces.

tokens.name: tangerine
tokens.usage: Game colour (Blind Timer). Fills, card tabs, the accent of that game's page. Text on it: `on-fill`.

tokens.name: mint
tokens.usage: Game colour (Reaction Chain). Text on it: `on-fill`.

tokens.name: grape
tokens.usage: Game colour (Odd One Out). Text on it: `on-fill`.

tokens.name: sky
tokens.usage: Game colour (Memory Path). Text on it: `on-fill`.

tokens.name: bubblegum
tokens.usage: Game colour (Pitch Match). Text on it: `on-fill`.

tokens.name: lagoon
tokens.usage: Game colour (Luckiest Person). Text on it: `on-fill`.

tokens.name: chili
tokens.usage: Game colour (Stack Tower), and the "wait" fill in reaction games. Text on it: `on-fill`. Not an error colour; errors use `danger`.

tokens.name: lime
tokens.usage: Game colour (Tug of Taps). Fills, card band, ticket stub, main key. Text on it: `on-fill` (9:1 or better).

tokens.name: coral
tokens.usage: Game colour (Tap Duel). Fills, card band, ticket stub, main key. Text on it: `on-fill` (9:1 or better).

tokens.name: aqua
tokens.usage: Game colour (This or That). Fills, card band, ticket stub, main key. Text on it: `on-fill` (9:1 or better).

tokens.name: sand

tokens.name: periwinkle
tokens.usage: Game colour (Angle Eye). Fills, card band, ticket stub, main key. Text on it: `on-fill` (9:1 or better).

tokens.name: peach

tokens.name: orchid
tokens.usage: Game colour (Color Recall). Fills, card band, ticket stub, main key. Text on it: `on-fill` (9:1 or better).

tokens.name: butter

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Text and icons for a good outcome ("Perfect!", a kept streak) on `surface`, `canvas` and `surface-sunken`. Always paired with a word or icon, never colour alone.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Text and marks for a miss (wrong tap, too early) on `surface` and `canvas`. Always paired with a word or icon; it differs from `success` by hue only.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: 3px solid `ink`, 2px offset, so it reads as a second outline around the element. Same contrast as `ink` in both themes.

tokens.name: whatsapp
tokens.usage: WhatsApp share key fill only. Text on it: `on-fill`.

styles.name: game-title
styles.usage: The game's name at the top of its page.

styles.name: result
styles.usage: The headline on a result ticket.

styles.name: card-title
styles.usage: Game names on cards and Play next.

styles.name: score-xl
styles.usage: The live number in a game: timers, rolls, reaction ms.

styles.name: share
styles.usage: The share-text preview, exactly as it will be pasted.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Stop a hidden clock at exactly the target time.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Verdicts and emphasis inside body text.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Uppercase labels: section titles, the Daily pill, ticket stub labels.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between attempt tiles; icon to text.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between keys in a row; grid cell gap.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between cards; stack gap inside a ticket section.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Page side gutter (minimum); padding inside small cards.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Padding inside the stage and the ticket.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between page sections.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Space above the how-to-play section and the footer.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Attempt tiles, grid cells under 40px.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Keys, grid cells, the share preview.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Stage, ticket, game cards.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Pills and the Daily badge.

shadow.note: The hard offset shadow is the system's one bold move: keys and cards sit on it and drop onto it when pressed.

tokens.name: shadow-key
tokens.usage: Keys at rest. On press, translate 4px down and use `shadow-key-pressed`.

tokens.name: shadow-key-pressed
tokens.usage: Keys while pressed.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Result ticket and game cards.

tokens.name: duration-press
tokens.usage: Key press-down.

tokens.name: duration-reveal
tokens.usage: Result ticket printing in.

tokens.name: border-edge
tokens.usage: Width of every `edge` outline.
